children: ), a creator of industry-leading litigation technology, today announced that it will report its financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026 before market open on Wednesday, November 4, 2026.

The financial results and business highlights will be discussed on a conference call and webcast scheduled at 7:30 a.m. Central Time (8:30 a.m. Eastern Time) on Wednesday, November 4, 2026. The conference call can be accessed by dialing (833) 461-5787 from the United States or +1 (585) 542-9983 internationally, with conference ID 812 832 646. The live webcast of the conference call can be accessed from DISCO’s investor relations website at ir.csdisco.com.
Following the completion of the call a webcast replay will be available at ir.csdisco.com for 12 months.
